lead_editorial.title: Arnab se pehle taiyari dikh rahi hai, ab 'zero casualty' ka vaada zameen par nibhana hoga
lead_editorial.summary: Lakh bhar logon ki evacuation, shelters aur crore phones par alert — Odisha aur Andhra ne pichhle toofanon se seekha hai. Par asli imtihaan landfall ke baad ke 72 ghante hain: bijli, paani, fasal aur machhuaaron ki rozi.
body: Cyclone Arnab Budhvaar subah Andhra Pradesh-Yanam coast se takraane wala hai, aur Mangalvaar ki tasveer ek tayyaar desh ki hai. AFP ke mutabik Andhra aur Odisha mein lagbhag 1 lakh logon ko ghar chhodne ko kaha gaya hai, Kakinada port par sabse ooncha 'Great Danger' signal 10 laga hai, aur Daily Pioneer ki live report ke mutabik Andhra ke 18 zilon mein 2.70 crore phones par alert bheje gaye hain. Cabinet Secretary ki adhyakshta mein National Crisis Management Committee ne agencies se 'zero loss of life' ka lakshya rakhne ko kaha hai.

Yeh taiyari sanyog nahi hai. 1999 ke Odisha super cyclone ke baad se India ne early warning, cyclone shelters aur samay par evacuation ka ek aisa model banaya hai jise duniya bhar mein saraha gaya hai. Garbhvati mahilaon ko pehle se aspataal pahunchana aur hazaron fishing boats ko kinare laana dikhata hai ki prashasan ab sirf hawa ki raftaar nahi, logon ki asurakshit sthiti ko bhi map kar raha hai.

Lekin hamari raay mein jaan bachaana pehla kadam hai, aakhri nahi. Landfall ke baad sabse bada nuksaan aksar bijli ke khambhon, peene ke paani, kachche gharon aur khet mein khadi fasal ka hota hai. IMD khud kachche gharon ke 'total destruction' aur fasalon ko vyapak nuksaan ki chetavani de chuka hai. Isliye restoration teams, bijli vibhag ke crew aur fasal-nuksaan ke survey ki taiyari bhi utni hi tez honi chahiye jitni evacuation ki.

Machhuaaron ko 30 October ki subah tak samundar mein na jaane ki salah hai — yaani kam se kam teen-chaar din ki kamaai band. Rajya sarkaron ko is dauraan unke liye turant raahat aur toofan ke baad nuksaan ka paardarshi muavza tay karna chahiye. Aur hum sab ke liye ek seedhi baat: sirf IMD aur sarkaari bulletins par bharosa karein, social media ki afwahon par nahi.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab: Kakinada port par sabse ooncha GD-10 signal, Andhra-Odisha mein lagbhag 1 lakh logon ko hatane ka aadesh; kal subah landfall
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik 'very severe' toofan Budhvaar forenoon mein Bapatla aur Visakhapatnam ke beech, Yanam ke paas coast paar karega. 70 se zyada trains radd, kai zilon mein school band.
body: Bay of Bengal mein Cyclone Arnab ka khatra ab aur nazdeek aa gaya hai. Daily Pioneer ki live report ke mutabik IMD ne Mangalvaar subah 11:30 baje toofan ko Visakhapatnam se lagbhag 170 km dakshin-poorv aur Kakinada se 180 km poorv-dakshin-poorv mein bataya. IMD ka anuman hai ki yeh 28 October ki forenoon mein Bapatla aur Visakhapatnam ke beech, Yanam ke paas Andhra coast paar karega. Report ke mutabik baad ke bulletins mein landfall par hawa 125–135 km/h aur jhonke 150 km/h tak bataye gaye; 1 se 1.5 meter tak storm surge ka bhi khatra hai, jiska sabse zyada asar East Godavari par pad sakta hai.

Kakinada port par sabse ooncha 'Great Danger Signal 10' laga hai, jabki Visakhapatnam aur Gangavaram par Signal 9 hai. AFP ke mutabik Andhra Pradesh aur Odisha mein lagbhag 1 lakh logon ko ghar khaali karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai — Indian media reports ke hisaab se lagbhag 50,000 Andhra mein aur 48,000 Odisha mein. Odisha ne 1,735 cyclone shelters khole hain. Pioneer ki report ke mutabik South Coast Railway ki radd trains ki sankhya 53 se badhkar 70 se zyada ho gayi hai aur Andhra ke 18 zilon mein 2.70 crore phones par alert bheje gaye.

Cabinet Secretary T V Somanathan ki adhyakshta wali National Crisis Management Committee ne agencies ko 'zero loss of life' ka lakshya rakhne ko kaha hai. Machhuaaron ko 30 October ki subah tak samundar mein na jaane ki salah hai. Toofan ke andar ki taraf badhne par Nepal ne bhi 29 se 31 October ke beech bhaari baarish, barfbaari aur avalanche ki chetavani jaari ki hai.

stories.title: J&K mein Omar Abdullah cabinet ka vistaar: NC ke chaar netaon ne li shapath, Congress statehood ke mudde par sarkar se bahar
stories.summary: LG Manoj Sinha ne Srinagar ke Lok Bhavan mein Ali Mohammad Sagar, Mir Saifullah, Shameema Firdous aur Altaf Ahmad Kaloo ko shapath dilayi. Vibhagon ka bantwaara abhi baaki.
body: Jammu-Kashmir mein Mukhyamantri Omar Abdullah ne Mangalvaar ko apne mantrimandal ka vistaar kiya. Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha ne Srinagar ke Lok Bhavan mein National Conference ke chaar netaon — Ali Mohammad Sagar, Mir Saifullah, Shameema Firdous aur Altaf Ahmad Kaloo — ko pad aur gopniyata ki shapath dilayi. WION ki report ke mutabik yeh pherbadal paanch maujooda mantriyon ke istife ke baad hua. Dynamite News ke mutabik naye mantriyon ke vibhag abhi tay hone baaki hain.

Congress ne vistaarit sarkar mein shaamil na hone ka faisla kiya hai. Party ka kehna hai ki woh Jammu-Kashmir ko poorn rajya ka darja waapas dilaane ki maang par kaayam hai aur tab tak sarkar ko bahar se samarthan degi.
Greater Kashmir ki report ke mutabik NC ke varishth neta Mubarak Gul ne mantrimandal se baahar rehne par niraasha jataayi. Shameema Firdous ka naam kai logon ke liye chaunkaane wala bataya gaya.

editorial.title: Cabinet badla, par J&K ka bada sawaal wahi — poorn rajya ka darja kab?
body: Omar Abdullah ka cabinet vistaar ek saamaanya prashasnik kadam hai, lekin Congress ka baahar rehna is baat ki yaad dilaata hai ki Jammu-Kashmir ki rajneeti abhi bhi statehood ke sawaal par atki hai. Ek Union Territory mein chuni hui sarkar ke paas seemit adhikaar hain, aur yeh tension har faisle mein dikhta hai.

Hamari raay mein naye mantriyon ko jald vibhag milne chahiye taaki shaasan par asar na pade. Saath hi Centre ko statehood ki bahaali par ek saaf roadmap saamne rakhna chahiye — chunavi janadesh ka samman aur logon ka bharosa, dono isi par tike hain.

stories.title: Israel mein aaj Knesset chunav: 73 lakh matdaata, Netanyahu ke bloc aur Eisenkot ke vipaksh mein kaanta muqabla
stories.summary: 120 seats wali Knesset ke liye 36 partiyaan maidan mein; exit polls India samay ke mutabik raat lagbhag 12:30 baje aane ki ummeed.
body: Israel mein Mangalvaar ko 26vi Knesset ke liye matdaan ho raha hai. Organiser ki report ke mutabik lagbhag 73 lakh log vote dene ke yogya hain aur 120 seats wali sansad ke liye 36 partiyaan maidan mein hain. Matdaan kendra Israel samay ke mutabik subah 7 se raat 10 baje tak khule hain — India mein yeh subah 9:30 se raat 12:30 baje tak hai. Kisi party ko sansad mein pahunchne ke liye kam se kam 3.25% vote chahiye.

WION ki report ke mutabik aakhri surveys mein Pradhan Mantri Benjamin Netanyahu ke bloc aur poorv IDF pramukh Gadi Eisenkot ki Yashar party ki aguvaai wale vipaksh ke beech kaanta muqabla dikha, aur dono ke bahumat se peechhe rehne ka anumaan hai. US President Donald Trump ne chunav se pehle do baar Netanyahu ka samarthan kiya tha.

Exit polls voting khatm hone ke turant baad, yaani India mein 28 October ki raat lagbhag 12:30 baje aane ki ummeed hai. Nayi sarkar banne tak Netanyahu ki maujooda sarkar caretaker ke roop mein kaam karti rahegi.

stories.title: Russia ke kabze wale Oleshky mein US ki madad se truce laagu, maanviya sahayta ke liye raasta khulega
stories.summary: Ukraine aur Russia ne Mangalvaar subah 3 baje se shahar mein ladaai roki; US First Lady Melania Trump ne samjhauta karaane mein bhoomika nibhaayi. Truce kitne din chalega, yeh saaf nahi.
body: Dakshini Ukraine ke Russia-kabze wale shahar Oleshky mein Mangalvaar ko sthaaniya samay subah 3 baje se truce laagu ho gaya, taaki wahan maanviya sahayta pahunch sake aur log chaahein to shahar chhod sakein. ABC News ke mutabik is samjhaute mein US First Lady Melania Trump ne madad ki; Ukraine ke negotiator Dmytro Lubinets ne bataya ki Russia ki human rights commissioner Yana Lantratova ka bhi sahyog raha.

Ukraini aur American anumaanon ke mutabik 2022 ke hamle se pehle Oleshky ki aabaadi lagbhag 24,000 thi, jo ab ghatkar lagbhag 2,000 reh gayi hai, jinmein 50 tak bachche shaamil hain. WION ki report mein wahan ke logon ke bhookhe hone ki baat kahi gayi hai. Russia ke raksha mantralaya ne Kherson ki taraf golabaari rokne ki baat kahi.

Abhi yeh saaf nahi hai ki truce kitne din chalega aur iski nigrani kaun karega. Isi beech Kyiv par Russi hamle jaari rahe. US ki madhyasthata mein Russia aur Ukraine ke beech baatcheet agle mahine phir shuru hone wali hai.

stories.title: Lula ki jeet ke baad Brazil ka bazaar dhadaam: Ibovespa lagbhag 14% gira, real 12% tak toota
stories.summary: Circuit breaker lagne se trading 30 minute ruki; niveshakon ko zyada sarkaari kharch aur ooncha byaaj dar ka dar.
body: Brazil mein Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ki chauthe kaaryakaal ki jeet par Somvaar ko bazaar ne tez pratikriya di. WION ke mutabik Ibovespa index 13.9% neeche band hua aur din mein 17% tak gir gaya — index ke itihaas ki sabse badi ek-din ki giraavaton mein se ek. Al Jazeera ke mutabik index 10% girne par circuit breaker laga aur trading 30 minute ke liye rok di gayi, jabki Brazilian real dollar ke mukaable lagbhag 12% kamzor hua.

Al Jazeera se baat karne wale analysts ke mutabik traders ne woh daav waapas liye jo Bolsonaro ki jeet aur sakht fiscal policy maan kar lagaaye gaye the. Niveshakon ko Lula ke daur mein zyada gharelu kharch aur oonchi byaaj daron ki ummeed hai, jabki desh ka sarkaari karz pehle hi GDP ke 82% se zyada hai. Flavio Bolsonaro ka nateeje na maanna bhi anishchitata badha raha hai.

editorial.title: Oleshky ka truce chhota hai, par bhookhe shahar ke liye yahi sabse bada sawaal hai
body: Ek chhote shahar mein kuchh dinon ki ladaai-bandi se jang khatm nahi hoti. Lekin jahan 24,000 ki aabaadi ghatkar 2,000 reh gayi ho aur log bhookh se jujh rahe hon, wahan khana, dawa aur surakshit nikaasi ka raasta khulna maayne rakhta hai.

Hamari raay mein is truce ki asli kasauti yeh hogi ki kya sahayta bina rok-tok pahunchti hai aur kya koi nishpaksh nigrani tantra banta hai. Agar yeh chhota prayog safal raha, to agle mahine hone wali baatcheet ke liye bharose ki ek eent ban sakta hai — aur agar fail hua, to yeh shanti prakriya ke liye ek aur chetavani hogi.

stories.title: Sensex-Nifty lagbhag sapaat band, par smallcap index 2.5% se zyada uchhla; banking aur IT mein munafavasooli
stories.summary: Sensex 8 ank girkar 73,598.67 aur Nifty 3 ank girkar 22,749.75 par band. Healthcare, telecom aur realty aage; Fed ke Budhvaar ke faisle se pehle saavdhaani.
body: Mangalvaar ko Indian share bazaar din bhar utaar-chadhaav ke baad lagbhag wahin band hua jahan se shuru hua tha. PTI ke hawaale se ThePrint ki report ke mutabik BSE Sensex 8.08 ank (0.01%) girkar 73,598.67 par aur NSE Nifty 3.45 ank (0.02%) girkar 22,749.75 par band hua. Din mein Sensex 73,179 aur 73,763 ke beech ghooma.

Bade sharon se ulat chhote aur madhyam share chamke — BSE SmallCap index 2.59% aur midcap index lagbhag 1% chadha. Sectors mein healthcare, telecom aur realty aage rahe. Sensex mein Bharti Airtel, Trent, Maruti aur Power Grid badhne walon mein the, jabki SBI, Axis Bank, TCS, Asian Paints, HDFC Bank aur ICICI Bank neeche rahe. Business Standard ke mutabik Nifty Media index 3.6% se zyada uchhla.

Report ke mutabik Saudi infrastructure par hamlon ke baad Brent crude lagbhag $115.8 prati barrel ke six-month high ke paas bana raha, aur US Federal Reserve ke Budhvaar ke faisle se pehle niveshak saavdhaan dikhe. Exchange data ke mutabik videshi sansthaagat niveshakon (FII) ne Somvaar ko ₹1,462.49 crore ke share beche.

stories.title: Jio Platforms ke shares Budhvaar ko NSE-BSE par list honge; ₹30,213 crore ka IPO 22 guna subscribe hua tha
stories.summary: Shares ₹1,119 ke upper price band par allot hue; aaj demat accounts mein credit aur refund ki prakriya.
body: Reliance ki digital company Jio Platforms ke shares Budhvaar, 28 October ko NSE aur BSE par list honge. Choice India ki report ke mutabik ₹30,213 crore ka yeh IPO poori tarah fresh issue tha — 27 crore naye shares — aur isme koi offer-for-sale nahi tha. Issue 21 se 23 October tak khula tha aur shares ₹1,065–1,119 ke price band ke upper end, yaani ₹1,119 par tay hue.

Report ke mutabik IPO kul 22.19 guna subscribe hua: QIB hissa 70.55 guna, NII lagbhag 14 guna aur retail hissa 2.72 guna. Lagbhag 1.39 crore applications aayin. Mangalvaar ko allottees ke demat accounts mein shares credit aur baaki logon ko refund ki prakriya hui; listing ke din regular trading subah 10 baje shuru hogi. (Yeh khabar sirf jaankari ke liye hai, nivesh salah nahi.)

stories.title: US Fed ka faisla Budhvaar raat: dar 3.75–4% par sthir rehne ki ummeed, par mehnge tel se mehngai ka dabav
stories.summary: September mein US consumer inflation 3.7% rahi; energy keematein saal bhar mein 20% se zyada badhin. Bazaar ki nazar aage dar badhaane ke sanket par.
body: US Federal Reserve Budhvaar, 28 October ko apni byaaj dar ka faisla sunaayega — India mein yeh Guruvaar tadke hoga. Investing.com ke analysis ke mutabik federal funds rate abhi 3.75%–4.00% ki range mein hai aur bazaar ise sthir rakhe jaane ki ummeed kar raha hai, haalaanki policymakers aage dar badhaane ka darwaaza khula rakh sakte hain.

Report ke mutabik September mein US consumer inflation 3.7% aur producer inflation 6.3% rahi, jabki core CPI 2.6% thi. Energy keematein saal bhar mein 20.4% badhin aur diesel 115% se zyada mehnga hua; Iran se jude sangharsh ko tel ke dabav ki ek badi wajah bataya gaya hai. ThePrint (PTI) ke mutabik Fed ke faisle se pehle ki saavdhaani Mangalvaar ko Indian bazaar par bhi dikhi.

editorial.title: Index sapaat, par andar hulchal: smallcap ki tezi aur Jio listing ke beech sanyam zaroori
body: Mangalvaar ka bazaar ek dilchasp tasveer dikhaata hai — Sensex aur Nifty lagbhag jahan ke tahan, lekin smallcap index 2.5% se zyada upar. Saath hi Budhvaar ko desh ke sabse bade IPOs mein se ek, Jio Platforms, list hone wala hai aur raat mein US Fed ka faisla aayega.

Hamari raay mein aise maahaul mein utsaah ke saath sanyam bhi zaroori hai. Crude $115 ke aas-paas hai, FIIs bech rahe hain aur global byaaj daron par anishchitata bani hui hai. Chhote niveshakon ko kisi bhi listing ya tezi ko 'pakka munafa' maanne se pehle apna risk samajhna chahiye — aur zaroorat ho to SEBI-registered salahkaar se baat karni chahiye.

stories.title: Abhishek Sharma ki 38 gend par 113 ki toofani pari, India ne Wellington mein 199 ka target 13.2 over mein chase kar NZ se series jeeti
stories.summary: 35 gend mein shatak aur 14 gend mein ardhashatak; Vaibhav Sooryavanshi ke saath 7.1 over mein 133 ki opening saajhedaari. India 3-0 se aage.
body: Wellington mein teesre T20I mein India ne New Zealand ko 8 wicket se haraakar paanch match ki series mein 3-0 ki ajey badhat le li. Outlook India ki report ke mutabik captain Shreyas Iyer ne toss jeetkar pehle gendbaazi chuni. New Zealand ne Daryl Mitchell ke naabad 89 (52 gend) ki madad se 198/3 banaaye, jisme Finn Allen ne 40 aur Devon Conway ne 39 ran jode.

Jawab mein Abhishek Sharma ne sirf 38 gend par 113 ran thok diye — 14 gend mein fifty aur 35 gend mein century. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi ne 19 gend par 45 ran banaaye aur dono ne pehle wicket ke liye 7.1 over mein 133 ran jode. Sanju Samson aur Naman Dhir ne naabad rehkar India ko 40 gend baaki rehte jeet dilaayi.

Report ke mutabik India ne 5 over mein 100 ran poore kar T20I mein sabse tez team century ka naya record banaaya, aur 2.2 over mein 50 tak pahunchkar sabse tez team fifty ki barabari ki. 190 se zyada ke safal chase mein sabse zyada gend baaki rehne ki list mein yeh jeet doosre number par hai.

sources.name: Outlook India — Records broken as Abhishek Sharma's ton seals series

stories.title: PM Modi ne Bharat Mandapam mein ESTIC 2026 ka udghatan kiya, kaha — India nayi soch ke saath aage badh raha hai
stories.summary: Teen din ke science conclave mein 12 focus areas, lagbhag 150 deep-tech startups; ISRO ke next-gen heavy launch vehicle aur Chandrayaan-4, 5 ke models pradarshit.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Mangalvaar ko New Delhi ke Bharat Mandapam mein Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC) 2026 ke udghatan samaaroh mein hissa liya. Amar Ujala ki report ke mutabik unhone kaha ki India nayi soch ke saath aage badh raha hai aur use duniya ka netritva karna chahiye. Unhone COVID-19 ke dauraan desh mein vaccine banaakar doosre deshon ko bhejne ka zikr kiya aur kaha ki viksit Bharat ke liye nuclear energy zaroori hai.

27 se 29 October tak chalne wale is conclave mein AI, biotechnology, advanced materials, health, energy, climate science aur ocean research samet 12 kshetron par charcha hogi. Lagbhag 150 deep-tech startups ke stalls hain. Report ke mutabik ISRO apne prastaavit next-generation heavy launch vehicle ka model dikha raha hai, jo low Earth orbit mein 30,000 kg se zyada le jaane ke liye design kiya gaya hai; Chandrayaan-4 aur Chandrayaan-5 ke models bhi pradarshit hain. Aayojan CSIR kar raha hai.

stories.title: Ranbir-Yash ki 'Ramayana' ki advance booking 1 lakh tickets ke paar, Diwali par career-best opening ki ummeed
stories.summary: Bollywood Hungama ke mutabik national chains mein pehle din ka lakshya lagbhag 5 lakh tickets; Akshay Kumar ki 'Mohra' se Diwali clash.
body: Nitesh Tiwari ki 'Ramayana: Part I' ki advance booking ne raftaar pakad li hai. Bollywood Hungama ki report ke mutabik Somvaar dopahar 2 baje tak national chains mein lagbhag 1 lakh tickets bik chuke the. Report ka anuman hai ki agar pehle din ke liye national chains mein lagbhag 5 lakh tickets bikte hain, to film North mein ₹60 crore ke aas-paas ki opening le sakti hai, aur non-national chains tay karenge ki aankda ₹70 crore paar karta hai ya nahi.

Report ke mutabik yeh Ranbir Kapoor aur Yash dono ke career ki sabse badi opening ho sakti hai, jo 'Animal' aur 'Toxic' ke lagbhag ₹50 crore (Hindi) ke opening aankde ko peechhe chhod degi; haalaanki 'Dhurandhar 2' ke pehle din ko paar karna mushkil bataya gaya hai. Film mein Sai Pallavi aur Sunny Deol bhi hain. Ek alag report mein Bollywood Hungama ne bataya ki Akshay Kumar ki 'Mohra' bhi isi Diwali release hogi.

editorial.title: Pehle 6 over mein 118 ran: T20 batting ka naya paimana, ab asli imtihaan bade tournament mein
body: Wellington mein India ki batting ne dikhaaya ki T20 cricket mein 'tez shuruaat' ka matlab ab kitna badal gaya hai. 199 ka target 13.2 over mein — yeh sirf ek jeet nahi, balki ek soch ka elaan hai ki powerplay mein hi match khatm kar diya jaaye. Abhishek Sharma aur Vaibhav Sooryavanshi jaise yuva openers is soch ka chehra ban rahe hain.

Hamari raay mein yeh aggression tabhi tikau hai jab middle order aur gendbaazi bhi utni hi mazboot ho — kyunki har pitch Wellington jaisi nahi hogi. 3-0 ki badhat ke baad baaki do match bench strength aazmaane ka sahi mauka hain.
